common.about.label: About Next Millionaire
common.about.title: A Co-operative Built on Shared Values
common.about.para1: Next Millionaire Co-operative was founded with a simple belief: when people work together with shared ownership and mutual accountability, extraordinary things happen. We unite members, consumers, and entrepreneurs into a resilient economic community.
common.about.para2: Our democratic structure ensures every member has a voice. Profits are reinvested into the community, creating lasting impact across generations.
common.mgmt.label: Leadership

common.dr.label: Commercial Fleet · Driver Program
common.dr.title: Rent a Car. Drive Your Way to Income.
common.dr.intro: We've built our own fleet step by step — now 12 cars strong and growing every month. Each vehicle is available for commercial rent on a simple monthly lease: you drive it for income, and you pay us monthly. No large upfront purchase, no long-term commitment.
common.dr.s1d: Fill out our Driver Registration Form with your details and driving experience.
common.dr.s2d: Our team reviews your application and documents, then reaches out to confirm.
common.dr.s3d: Sign your monthly lease, pick up your car, and start driving for income.
common.dr.fleetSubtitle: Browse our vehicles below. An "Apply to Rent" button means the car is open — a "Booked" badge means it's already leased.
common.footer.tagline: Building community wealth through shared ownership.
